questions.question: By default, how does useSelector decide whether to re-render a component after a dispatch?
options: It deep-compares the new and old selector results
It re-renders whenever the action type matches the component's slice
It compares the new selector result with the previous one using reference equality (===)
It always re-renders every subscribed component
questions.explanation: useSelector reruns the selector after every dispatch and re-renders only if the result is a different reference. That is why returning new objects or arrays causes extra renders.

questions.question: Why does `useSelector(s => ({ a: s.a, b: s.b }))` re-render the component on every dispatch, even unrelated ones?
options: The object literal is a new reference each time, so the === comparison always fails
s.a and s.b are deep-cloned by Immer on every action
Destructuring in selectors disables memoization in React
questions.explanation: A new object is created on each call. Fix it by using two selectors that return the values directly, or by passing shallowEqual as the equality function.

questions.question: A list of 500 rows re-renders completely when one item's amount changes. Which change scales best?
options: Wrap the parent list in React.memo only
Have the parent select the whole slice so it changes less often
Have the parent select only the ids, and each memo-wrapped row select its own item by id
questions.explanation: With ids in the parent and per-row selection by id, only the row whose data changed sees a new selector result, so only that row re-renders.

questions.question: A component uses an RTK Query hook but only needs one fund from the returned list, and it re-renders during every background refetch. What is the targeted fix?
options: Use selectFromResult to return only the needed fund, so the hook re-renders only when that value changes
Move the query into a thunk
questions.explanation: selectFromResult lets the hook pick part of the query state; the result is shallow-compared, so status changes like isFetching no longer trigger re-renders unless they are selected.
